Section 5.01 Developer and Owner desire that construction of Developer's New
Building can proceed expeditiously. Accordingly, Owner hereby grants to Developer the
following temporary licenses for access and construction (together, the “Developer
Access Licenses"):

To store any materials and equipment on the Townhouse Property as necessary to

Section 5.02 Owner shall not object to, obstruct, or interfere with Developer's
exercise of its rights under Section 5.01, above. Developer agrees to perform the
Developer's Construction Work:
In accordance with all applicable legal requirements (including, without
limitation, the obtaining of and compliance with all required permits and other
governmental and quasi-governmental approvals and compliance with all
governmental and quasi-governmental requirements);
(b) In a prompt, safe and efficient manner; and
(c) In accordance with good construction practices and in a customary manner for
such work.
Section 5.03 In connection with, and during the construction of Developer's
New Building, Developer may be required to construct non-permanent scaffolding,
barriers, fencing, or similar equipment (the “Scaffolding") on the Townhouse Land,
which may encroach in a minor manner on or over the Townhouse Property. Owner
hereby consents to such minor encroachment and grants Developer a temporary license
for such encroachment (the “Scaffolding _License") provided that the Scaffolding is
installed or used and maintained in accordance with the standards set forth in the above
Section 5.02.
Section 5.04 In connection with, and during the construction of Developer's
New Building, Developer may operate a crane or like equipment on Developer's Land,
the Townhouse Land, or the street or sidewalk adjacent to Developer's Land and the
Townhouse Land, which equipment may encroach on or over the Townhouse Property
during its operation. Owner hereby consents to such encroachment and grants Developer
a temporary license for such encroachment (the “Crane License"), provided the crane
and other equipment is installed or used and maintained in accordance with standards set
forth in the above Section 5.02.
